test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A vendor sold 25 laptops at a profit of 12% and 15 laptops at a profit of 20%. If he had sold all the 40 laptops at a profit of 18%, his profit would have increased by Rs. 30,000. What is the cost price of each laptop, if the cost price of all the 40 laptops is the same?
solution:
**Given:**

A vendor sold 25 laptops at a profit of 12% and 15 laptops at a profit of 20%. If he had sold all 40 laptops at a profit of 18%, his profit would have increased by Rs. 30,000. The cost price of all the 40 laptops is the same.

**Formula Used:**

Let the cost price of each laptop be C Rs.

Total cost price of 40 laptops = 40C Rs.

Profit from 25 laptops at 12% = 25 × C × 12/100

Profit from 15 laptops at 20% = 15 × C &ti
